text:
sachin: Heads up — detected a batch of long-lived Vault leases on path secret/data/partners/* that didn't get auto-revoked. KMS unwrap logs also show gaps around 2024-11-09 04:12 UTC. Likely RBAC drift after last terraform apply. Need quick sweep + credential rotation plan. Anyone on call?

emily: Can you paste the lease IDs and the vault path? I can check audit logs.

sachin: lease ids: lease_abc123, lease_def456, lease_ghi789 (redacted). Affected services: partner-ingest, partner-archive. Path is secret/data/partners/partner-*.

khushbu: @sachin can you confirm whether these were created by the old 'partner-ingest' service account or the new workload SA? If it's old SA we should revoke both tokens and rotate keys.

sachin: looks like a mix — some tokens issued via svc-partner-ingest@redwood-infer. Gonna dump bindings.

vault-bot: Detected lease TTL override on secret/data/partners/partner-42. Suggest immediate revoke for leases older than 30d. Action: revoke_initiated (controller#revoke-2024-11-09T04:28Z).

sec-oncall: ok — emergency plan: 1) revoke leases; 2) rotate KMS wrapped secrets for affected buckets; 3) run RBAC audit against terraform state; 4) notify partners. Who can run the revoke and rotation now? :rotating_light:

maria: I can take revoke + rotation for partner-ingest. Will need the exact repo + runbook. @ops-bot can you queue a terraform plan to list bindings? :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Queued: terraform plan -refresh-only -var='env=prod' in infra/iam at commit 9a7f3b3. ETA ~3m.

emily: I'll pull audit logs from KMS: gcloud logging read 'resource.type=kms_key AND timestamp>"2024-11-08T00:00:00Z"' --limit 1000 and cross-ref with vault audit. Also check centralized audit-forwarder.

sachin: adding quick snippets — vault: ```vault lease list -format=json | jq '.[] | select(.path|startswith("secret/data/partners/"))'``` KMS: ```gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.UnwrapCryptoKey"' --limit 1000```

khushbu: If RBAC drift is terraform drift, we should tag affected SAs and schedule a refactor of the module. For immediate containment, rotate SA keys and re-issue least-priv creds.

maria: Starting revoke now. I'll run `vault lease revoke -id lease_abc123` && `vault lease revoke -id lease_def456` && `vault lease revoke -id lease_ghi789`. Posting live.

sachin: noted. @maria please also mark tickets in the incident tracker with assets and assign to sec team.

maria: done — incident #INC-2024-459 created, assigned to sec-oncall + khushbu + ops. I'll paste output in ~10m.

vault-bot: revoke successful: lease_abc123, lease_def456. lease_ghi789 failed -> token already expired.

maria: rotation started for partner-ingest KMS wrapped key. Command: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key=partner-ingest-key --location=global --key-ring=redwood-infra` && update wrapped blob in vault. Pushing PR to infra repo.

ops-bot: terraform plan output attached (snippet):
```
No changes. 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
```
Note: state shows svcacc binding for svc-partner-ingest in module partner_service, but last applied by user: deploy-bot at 2024-05-10.

emily: KMS audit shows unwrap calls from partner-ingest around the leaks timeframe, but source IPs look odd (2 different CIDR blocks). Escalating to network for possible token theft.

khushbu: ok — action items: (A) Ops to rotate SA keys and re-issue tokens (B) Sec to rotate KMS wrapping keys and rewrap secrets (C) Infra to add a terraform guard to prevent lease TTL override >30d (D) Postmortem to cover how RBAC was changed outside TF. Assign owners?

sachin: owners: ops -> @maria, sec -> @khushbu, infra -> @emily. I'll own postmortem writeup.

maria: ops action started. Will rotate SA keys and publish notes to the partners mailing list. ETA 2h for full rotation.

sec-oncall: good. Also enable KMS audit-forwarder high-fidelity pipeline for partner keys (temp retention 90d).

sachin: thanks all. Keep updates here. If we find partner data exfil, we'll invoke incident response.

emily: update: collected KMS unwrap logs and saved to GCS gs://sec-exports/INC-2024-459/unwraps.json

maria: all SA keys rotated for partner-ingest. New tokens issued and pushed to vault path secret/data/partners/partner-42. Marking task as done.

khushbu: I submitted change to infra module to clamp lease TTL and added a pre-commit check (policy: max-lease-ttl=30d) PR #421. Also added audit alert rule for TTL overrides.

sachin: closing loop: revocations done, KMS rotation in progress, infra guard PR open, incident ticket updated with timeline. Last check-in 2024-11-09T06:14Z. Thanks.
